learning.text: each week the engine studies the work that failed, and proposes improvements to skills and agent.md, by pull request only

toReview.cause: a stream that fails halfway leaves a truncated file and no error
toReview.rule: When you stream a response, decide what the reader sees if it fails halfway: end the stream with an error line, log it, and test that failure.

candidates.cause: the implementer calls a helper that does not exist yet
candidates.rule: Before you use a helper, find it with grep; write it in the same change when it is missing.

history.rule: Add a line under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md for each change a user sees.
